answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies including the senate, while the vice president for studies is not explicitly stated as a member.
The chancellor is responsible for the budget and the vice president for studies does not handle budget planning.
Appointment matters are separate from studies and leadership roles do not grant access to all bodies.
The vice president for studies operates across the university rather than sitting on a single faculty council.
The vice president for studies is responsible for degree programmes across the university, but study commissions belong to specific faculties.
Examination boards decide on individual faculty matters and the vice president does not sit on them.
Research funding is handled within faculties by researchers and associates.
Module revision is handled at the degree programme level within faculties.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a specific faculty matter.
Orientation week planning is organized at the faculty level for new students.
